title: [2.8.2] Failed meal bolus queued and administered along with the reentered one
symptom: While using the Bolus Wizard, the SMB was administered and caused the meal bolus to fail. The caretaker checked the pump and saw the last bolus was 0.1u, so she reentered the meal and AAPS sent both meal boluses to the pump.
cause: The first attempt of the second bolus was refused because the previous bolus was still running; the second attempt was executed after the first bolus finished. The issue may be related to the SMB bolus hijacking the progress dialog, which is a known problem to be improved in version 3.0.
fix: The behavior was deemed correct by the developer; the user should wait for the bolus to appear in the Combo tab. The issue with the dialog disappearing is to be improved in version 3.0.
evidence_quote: from what i see AAPS behavior was correct first attempt of 2nd bolus was refused because previous bolus was still running second attempt of 2nd bolus was executed because it was after finish of 1st bolus
